correctness.rationale: Deck marker-marker orientations fix their permutation and marker-prefix pair counts fix every binary gap composition. Only the ab-count varies: H plus independent 0..a_s b_s intervals by adjacent swaps, so the exact feasible values and Gaussian convolution multiplicities follow. Summing S+1 across weak compositions via symmetry yields r! binom(A+r,r) binom(B+r,r)(1+AB/(r+1)); the proof explicitly handles empty individual gaps and every A,B,r>=1. Direct pair-deck enumeration independently agrees with all predicted complete fibers in 36 tested parameter triples (23,526 words); tests are finite corroboration.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural fixed-composition family with two repeated symbols and arbitrarily many unique labeled marker symbols, appropriate to short-subsequence readouts. It gives an all-parameter count of all distinguishable decks, hence the optimal zero-error readout code size, and explicit coefficient formulas for every collision multiplicity. Those fiber data and finite exact counts are not determined by known broad polynomial bounds or generic enumeration procedures, and no arbitrary length cutoff is selected.
